razorhill_guard_1: This is Razor Hill. We hold the road between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar, and we've held it since the hill had nothing on it. The inn and the wyvern roost are in the middle of town; the only gate is the south one.
razorhill_smith: Kragg. I run Razor Hill's forge - blades and plate for the patrols, and repairs for anyone with coin. Bring me ore and I'll turn it into something that bites back.
razorhill_trainer: Grokk, weapons trainer. Nakhtar sends his recruits up from the valley to me and I find out what they actually learned. Come back when your arm's tired of swinging. That's where the training starts.
razorhill_innkeep: Grosk. This is Razor Hill's inn - a bed, a meal, and a hearth to call home. Rest a while. The road to Orgrimmar is long and Durotar doesn't forgive tired feet.
razorhill_guard_2: South gate - the only way in or out of Razor Hill. Turn north on the highway for Orgrimmar, south for the valley road and the Echo Isles landing. Trouble's come from both.
razorhill_guard_3: You've got the look of someone fresh out of the Valley. The highway's just outside this gate. Stay on it until you know what lives beside it.
razorhill_goblin_trader: Kravel Coinsnatch, trader. I buy what the patrols bring in and sell what they need going out, and I have a few jobs that pay better than either. Everything has a price - even the conversation. Just kidding. Mostly.
razorhill_beltelf_scribe: Aendel Duskrunner. I keep Razor Hill's ledgers for the Horde - who was paid, who is owed, who did not come back. Someone has to. It was never going to be the orcs.
razorhill_human_defector: Corlan Ashe. I stopped believing the Alliance's version of things a long time ago, and the Horde took me in when nobody else would. I do what work Razor Hill will give a human, which is more than you'd think.
razorhill_orc_farmer: Kagra. I farm the west side of the hill. The soil out here fights you for every root, and I've learned to fight back harder. If you eat in this town, some of it was mine.
razorhill_child: When I grow up I'm going to kill a whole cave full of demons by myself. Skull Rock's got one. My mother says I'm not allowed to go and look.
razorhill_elder_orc: Ulaka. I remember when this hill had nothing on it but wind and bones - I carried stone for the first wall. Look at it now. We built something, and you're standing in it.
razorhill_goblin_engineer: Prizzle Boltwrench, engineer. I've got seven inventions in various states of exploding, and statistically one of them will work. Stand over there. Further.
razorhill_troll_refugee: Tal'rashi. I be Darkspear, from da Echo Isles - I got out when Zalazane turned on his own. Not everyone did. Dere's a camp of us still holdin' on out dere, across da water south-east of Razor Hill.
razorhill_flight_master: Zhaka, windrider master. The wyverns are fed and the wind is fair. I fly to anywhere you've already walked to - tell me where.
ct_razorhill: Zogar. I train every discipline for Razor Hill - warrior, shaman, whatever you turned out to be. Show me where you've got to and bring coin.
pt_razorhill_forge: Orgha, at the forge. I teach mining and smithing together - no sense knowing where to dig if you can't do anything with what comes out. Ore in one hand, hammer in the other.
pt_razorhill_herbs: Kagra, apothecary. I teach herbalism and alchemy both: which plant to pull, and what to do with it afterwards. The second part is where people go wrong.
pt_razorhill_wood: Hulda. Woodcutting and woodworking - fell it, saw it at the mill behind me, make something of it. A plank is just a bow that hasn't happened yet.
pt_razorhill_hide: Urzul, tanner. Skinning, leatherworking, tailoring and cooking all come across my bench, and I teach the lot - a skinner who throws the meat away goes hungry holding a full pack.
pt_razorhill_essence: I teach engineering: metal, a crystal out of an ore vein, and a steady hand. Bring me the first two and I'll see about the third.
